layout.description: 6-column newspaper broadsheet: equal columns, 16px tight gutters. Maximum information density. The newspaper is the interface.

utilities..brutal-divider: border-top: 2px solid #000000 — horizontal rule as section boundary
utilities..brutal-rule: border-left: 2px solid #000000 — vertical rule for column separation
utilities..brutal-full: grid-column: 1 / -1 — full-bleed span across all 6 columns

_twist.description: Newspaper broadsheet: replaced symmetric 3-column with 6 equal columns, tight 16px gutters. Container padding compressed to 16px — content touches edges. Brutal utility classes: .brutal-divider (2px border-top), .brutal-rule (2px border-left), .brutal-full (span all 6), .brutal-half (span 3), .brutal-third (span 2). This is a broadsheet, not a landing page grid.
